nom: Mario Badescu Aloe Vera Alcohol-Free Toner

avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin due to rosacea, so I try to avoid anything that will obliterate my face. This is soft and gentle to use. Subtle fragrance but feels nice and clean before any serums. Also, can't beat the price especially while it's on sale!
i love this product! it leaves my skin feeling so clean and soft! highly recommend!!!
Basic, effective, gentle, soothing & moisturizing toner. Preps my skin for the rest of my skincare steps.
I use this toner daily. It helps return my skin to the proper PH levels as well as hydrating my skin.

I wanted to like this toner, it smells good and feels clean going on, overall does its job. But I was getting tiny red spots that resemble mild rosacea across both cheeks from it. Within about a week or two of finishing this bottle and switching to a different brand toner, the spotting cleared right ip.
This is a moisturizing, calming toner that I use daily! No drying ingredients to strip my skin, it feels so smooth and hydrated after I use it.

avis.titre: I keep coming back for more!
avis.texte: I use it right after washing my face. Honestly this is the only Mario badescue product I use and I love it. I feel like this toner helps reduce scars left behind by nasty pimples. I had a dark spot from scarring that I thought would never go away and after I started using this toner I noticed it getting lighter and lighter til I couldn't notice it anymore. Now it's the only toner I'll use.
Love Mario products. I switched to pure witch hazel and it almost ruined my skin. This is forever my go to toner.
I haven't tried many others as I found this one years ago. Oily skin but sensitive to breakouts and dry patches. This keeps my skin refreshed and clean feeling always. Love this product!!
Hands down the best toner I've ever used. I have dry, sensitive skin. For that price, I haven't found anything that works better for me.
This product is perfect for me. I have sensitive skin and need added hydration.

avis.titre: Refreshing and doesn't dry my skin out
avis.texte: I've tried many toners over the years and was skeptical of this because it was so much cheaper than the others. However, my dry, acne prone skin loves it! It's super soothing and tones my skin well. Highly recommended.
This is literally fragrance with alcohol diluted with water. Zero benefit and can actually be irritating. A ridiculous product hyped up with marketing. No no nooo

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life
avis.texte: Get rid of whatever other toner you own, because this is all you ever needed. I have typically normal skin, but when the weather decides that my skin should be dry...my skin is DRRRYYYYYYY!!! Like watch my skin flake from my hot burning face dry. Sooo I decided, you know let's try this 7 skins technique as if my skin care routine wasn't already ridiculous. After much research I thought I'd try this product for 7 skins. Most skincare products need a build up to see results...not this stuff. First time I used it....amazing!!!! Like the heavens opened from above and gave me gods gift to the softest and most hydrated skin ever. So if you don't hate yourself use this product.

I do not normally have dry skin, however I moved to a much colder climate and this winter weather has zapped the moisture in my face. After only a week of using the aloe vera toner, I noticed a huge improvement in my skin's texture and moisture. This is my first Mario Badescu purchase. Eager to try more!

This is an incredible toner for dry skin. I know toners aren't necessary but I like using one. I have always liked it but when I ran out I was like "oh no I can tell what's missing!" This is doing wonderful things for my akin. Feels refreshing and not stripping.

I love the Mario Badescu line and this is no difference. I use the glycolic gel cleanser and then this, then a moisturizer and I alternate between using an oil or not. The toner is refreshing. I like to wait a couple seconds for it to dry before applying moisturizer.

The first time I ever bought this stuff (about a year ago now), I chose it mostly because it had a lot of good reviews and it was a decent price. Honestly, I didn't even realize that it was doing anything for my skin until it ran out. I didn't immediately buy another bottle because I wasn't convinced that it was a necessary step in my routine, but after a week with out it, my skin became so dry and irritated, I couldn't get my hands on another bottle fast enough! That being said, I will never be without it again!

avis.titre: I wanted to love this product so bad :(
avis.texte: I saw all the good reviews and the website ratings so I tried it. I usually have clear skin with little effort (good genes I guess lol) so I decided to try it. (For reference I have sensitive dry skin and deal with eczema flare ups from time to time) The first couple of times I used it, my skin felt great! BUT then my face started to break out in little bumps all over my face. After not using it for a week, my skin started to clear up again. Would not recommend.

This feels refreshing when applying after washing my face and definitely seems to be good for my dry, sensitive skin! I have some redness in certain areas, and i try to apply it directly there sometimes but it doesn't seem to do a whole lot for that. Overall, it's nice for what it's intended for!

I have rebought multiple times and it has been a miracle worker for my SUPER sensitive acne prone skin. It doesn't dry or irritate but still has toner power, I use it twice a day. The ingredient list is safe too, I would just love if they didn't use dye in the product. Amazing!!!

I bought this because I had to get committed to a skincare routine after constant break outs and irritation. I use this after cleansing, as well as before and after masks, and I use it after dermaplaning. This soothes my sensitive and easily irritated skin immediately. I've only been using it for about a month but I can tell it really helps. There is a faint scent but I don't mind it. I typically have combination skin and often get blackheads on my chin and jawline so I can't speak for how well it works on other skin types.

I've used the MB Rosewater Facial Spray for a while now, and I really liked it as an add-on to help my dry skin. Since I liked that so much, I bought this since I do have sensitive skin as well, and I've been looking for a better toner. The scent is very very light and natural smelling (like a sweet aloe of course), and although it does just feel like "water" it is also a toner so keep that in mind. Other toners tend to make my skin red from irritation and smell too strong. Not this one! Will be purchasing again :)

As a 28 year old, I figured it was time to start a skin care routine. After lots of research, I decided to get this for my toner. It feels so refreshing on my face, a little bit cool! It's been about 2 weeks and my pores are looking smaller and I feel more fresh faced! I use this twice a day- morning and evening.

I wanted a toner that was gentle but helped exfoliate a little too without irritating. This is very very mild. I wasnt sure I was going to like it after I used it the first time. Felt like water going on honestly. I used it twice more and I started to feel the difference. It really does balance your skin out. Its a toner but its not. I think I want something a little more stronger for next time but its a very nice toner. Doesnt smell at all. Unscented. I like that you squirt as much as you want on your cottonball and no mess.
This toner is amazing for sensitive skin, I love the way it feels and it does a great job calming redness. Mario Badescu products are well worth the price.

I have very sensitive skin with a combination texture. This is gentle enough for my dry cheeks but works well enough to tone my oily t-zone. this leaves no residue yet my skin always feels clean and soothed after each use.
Toner is great! Doesn't feel like my skin is burning after applying to skin
I use the toner after I wash my face then I use a serum And last I moisturized I use all the Mario Bedescu products

Many toners are too harsh on my sensitive skin, but this one is very delicate and does the job without stripping every ounce of moisture from my skin like some toners tend to do. It has a light delicate smell that I find pleasant. Have repurchased a few times and will continue to do so.

My skin is very sensitive to products, and this is one of the few that works for me. I've used 6+ bottles over the years, and the one I just received is different. But it's better! My skin seems clearer and more hydrated with this new one. It's the most no-frills toner you can find, no fancy claims, just balances out your skin after cleansing. There are 2-3 new ingredients, and they surprisingly don't irritate my skin. The dispenser also allows less product out, which is good because it's the consistency of water. If you liked this before, you'll like the new formula.

I have sensitive skin and it's dry, this doesn't break me out or leave my skin irritated I like that it has simple ingredients in it. I recommend, I have tried higher end ones but they all it rated my skin or gave me a reaction. This one doesn't. If you have sensitive skin I would try it!
Doesn't sting my face at all. This would be awesome if it didn't have fragrance and coloring in it.

Guys stop buying this. It is literally perfume for your face. Sure it feels refreshing but it actually when it evaporations it pulls moisture from your skin into the air. The fragrance will also cause irritation over time. Please try dermalogica or cosrx. It is more money but they will benefit your skin unlike anything from Mario Badescu
Upon the first two uses my skin felt really cooled down and refreshed, but on the third use I woke up to my skin peeling off in itchy hives...

avis.titre: Least worst ingredients list but still bad product.
avis.texte: I still don't see why a toner is needed or recommended. It's an unnecessary step - ask any professional dermatologist.
My daughter has acne prone skin. She loves this toner because it also moisturizes.
I've been buying this toner for over a year now and never had a problem with it, never smelled bad This recent one I've got smells really strange and bad Would like a refund!!!!!!
This toner is amazing! It doesn't break me out and is gentle on my sensitive skin.

I've replaced this product as soon as it's run out 4 or 5 times now. I like it for packing a few more (possibly soothing?) layers of water onto my skin before applying an HA serum, but my absolute favorite use for it is decanting it into a spray bottle to use as a mist for my face and hair. So many facial mists are packed with fragrances & perfumes (no good for sensitive skin), and most moisturizing/taming hair mists are mostly silicone (too heavy for my baby fine hair). I love using this to turn my frizz into cute flyaways, on my hair under salt sprays to keep things from getting too sticky and crunchy, over a matte foundation to make things a little more natural, to cool my face & add a little glow in the middle of the day... THE best multi-use spray. Seriously.
I use this every day after I wash my face and before I start my makeup routine
I swear by this toner and it's a vital part of my skincare routine. Purchased maybe 3 times, will continue to buy.

I love it so much! No strong smells, no weird sensations, and my skin doesn't feel overly dry or right like it does with other skin products. Ever since using this toner, my skin has become way less problematic. It's much more even in both color and texture, and so smooth! Coupled with my Clinique lotion, I don't think my skin has looked this good in a looong time! My foundation is finally going on flawlessly.

I ordered this online during the 21 days of beauty deals. I only used this product 2 times and my whole face broke out into hundreds of little bumps. The product smelled like a wet, moldy towel. I returned it in an Ulta store and compared it to one of the new bottles they had for sale and they smelled completely different... I don't know what was in the product I received but I'm afraid I may have permanently damaged my skin. I stopped using it a week ago and the bumps have started to go away with a lot of benadryl and steroid cream I got from the dermatologist, but my skin is still not even close to what it use to be. I contacted ulta's costumer service so I hope this doesn't happen to anyone else! But please beware before you put this product on your face! I'm still living with the side effects...

avis.auteur: Dry skin sensitive skin and acne skin
avis.texte: I have dry skin and sensitive skin and lots of acne issues. I've been looking for a new skin care routine to help with this, and this is perfect.
I was so excited to get this, but right away I've noticed it's caused small acne spots to break out all over my face while also not combatting redness. really disappointed by this product :/

This did absolutely nothing for my skin. I bought this for its claim that it protects the moisture barrier of the skin. I even used it less than a minute after coming out of the shower. I have combo skin and this felt and acted like water. I only use this to wipe the T-zone oils from my face. I used to use water. This also does not take off makeup. Don't be fooled by the good reviews.
I repurchase this again and again and recommend to all of my friends. Must have

I have great skin with minimal effort. I've never been prone to breakouts and after dealing with upset skin for over a month I concluded it had to be this and the enzyme gel. Also after using this I noticed my skin was super dry but I didn't think anything of it because I'd follow up with serum and moisturizer. BFor the first time in my life I had continuous breakouts and dark marks as a result. It only took a week off of this for my skin to begin recovering. I am black and have normal/dry skin. I'm most concerned with hyperpigmentation, dryness and dullness.

I've been using this daily for almost two years. It's never let me down. It's so hydrating, but not greasy or oily feeling. After cleansing and exfoliating, my skin is usually stripped from moisture, and this brings my skin back to life every time. It's very calming, no harsh scents, plus the aloe helps your skin a ton when you're sunburnt. 10/10 would recommend.

ive gone through half of this bottle so far and i LOVE it!! leaves my skin glowy and clean feeling doesn't burn when it's put over sunburn unlike most products. also calms redness would recommend and would buy another bottle

avis.titre: I would purchase this product again
avis.texte: I have dry and sensitive skin and this toner does not irate my skin.

i picked up this toner cause the ingredients are few & i wanted a break from more complicated formulas. that being said, it was nice but wasn't magic for my skin. i know i know, i wasn't expecting a miracle. besides i actually have more oily acne prone skin, rather than dry & sensitive skin that this product was designed for. but i was hopeful! i do appreciate how the aloe calmed down my redness & flare ups, so there's an upside! so if you have redness, give this one a shot..!

Bought this on a trip where the water was super hard so needed something to wipe the minerals off my face after washing. This was suggested by an employee who I informed of my skin troubles. This product slowly but surely ruined my skin. Thinking it's the methylparaben and coloring. Used for two months not realizing my acne was from this and not stress/hormones. HUGE MISTAKE. I broke out in places I've never had acne before. I have to deal with terrible scarring now. If you're a no wearing makeup kind of person like me, you know how terribly this has affected me, I've spent many days and nights in avoiding going out in public and honestly have cried over how messed up this made my skin. Sensitive skin individuals - STAY AWAY! Don't let the "aloe" fool you.

52 years old here and skin has been dry. I was looking for a MILD toner that didn't have alcohol and wouldn't irritate or dry out my skin. If you have dry skin or sensitive skin, this product is PERFECT! Love it!
I always go back to this toner despite trying "higher end" brands. Highly recommend!

I used the toner twice a day when I first started then after about three weeks I started seeing a change. After six weeks my face was finally one tone and I was able to use once a day; in the morning after I wash my face.

I bought this on accident, but I love it. I meant to restock my Aloe Lotion and bought this Aloe Vera Toner instead... ironically the "lotion" has isopropyl alcohol in jt but the toner doesn't. It doesn't dry me out as much as the Aloe Lotion at all and it has a pleasant feeling on the face. My skin is typically combination / acne prone. In winter it's dry and flaky and in summer it's an oily mess no matter what products I use. However, Mario Badescu products always curb my breakouts. I'm going to continue buying this!

AHHHHHH, why have I not been using this sooner? Picked this up about 2 weeks ago because I have alot of acne scarring and I heard toners help even texture and discoloration. I began using this with very little expectations but was pleasantly surprised when about 4 days ago, I noticed my face looked more even! I'm pretty sure I have this wonderfuk product to thank for that! I have never felt so comfortable without foundation on. I am so pleased with this. I have very very sensitive skin, and this did not break me out or dry my skin. I would 1000000000% recommend this. I put this on twice a day with a cotton ball, once at night and once in the morning.

There's almost nothing to this toner so I must be allergic to the aloe or the dye they use. My face turns pink and feels hot immediately. Had an even worse reaction to the aloe moisturizer (used at separate times)

I've noticed a huge change in my skin texture, tone, and dryness since using this product. I usually use this twice a day, but sometimes once a day in the evening is good enough for me. My skin is sensitive and Rosacea prone with dryness. I feel that this product has made my skin glow. It looks healthier and smoother. It also isn't breaking out as much with redness as it was before. This stuff also adds much needed moisture making my skin look less dry.
Great and gentle for sensitive skin. It doesn't burn and it feels quite cooling due to the Aloe Vera.

I love this toner. I have combination skin- really oily patches accompanied with really dry patches. I use this toner at night before I go to bed to help even out my skin tone and in the morning to help remove excess oil. It doesn't dry out my dry skin and it removes extra oil from my face. Win win! I love it and this product line
Did feel refreshing when put as a light spray but horrible as a toner. It was as if I was using water
Amazing toner! I use it everyday and after 2 days made my skin looking clear and less oily and feeling soft!

I am in love with this toner! I have textured skin due to inflation and also old hyperpigmentation marks from acne. This toner calms the inflammation down so my skin looks extremely smooth. This toner also helps fade some of my old hyperpigmentation. I would recommend this for all skin types. I have combo skin so it gives my skin the right amount of moisture without my skin getting super oily through out the day. I highly recommend!

My dry sensitive rosacea skin seems to be liking this product. I try to use it twice a day but as of right now it's more in the evening. My skin reacts to a lot of facial products due to sensitivity. I ordered this online and started using this less than a week ago. So far I like it and will continue using it.

This is amazing! My skin has dried up so much after getting on Birth Control (iud). I use this after I cleanse my face, and if I have any pimples this dries them out ASAP! Leaves my skin feeling fresh and does not dry. Although, it feels that way at first after a few minutes your skin feels soft.

I use proactiv and I love it but it dries my skin out like crazy. Even with a heavy moisturizer my skin always felt so dry and flaky. I started using this before I moisturized and after the proactiv and the results are amazing. It calms the redness on my skin somewhat, but more importantly it has made my skin overall smoother and also not flaky and dry anymore. Well worth the money.
I use this toner every day. I use it before bed and before I apply my makeup. It's a cooling feeling on my face.

avis.titre: Finally have a toner that isn't harsh.
avis.texte: I didn't realize how harsh my other toner was until I tried this one. This toner is SO gentle and it doesn't burn. It's not loaded with alcohol and other things that dry out your skin.
I use this project morning and night. Have to use an extra creamy moisturizer because of the drying effect, but other than that great product

This is the first toner i have tried and i won't try anything else!! It helps my dryness a lot and i like to use the rose hips oil after from Mario Badescu as well and it's a great combo. This toner is amazing and i love it !

I never write reviews...but that's how great this toner is! I am currently on a prescribed treatment for severe cystic acne and still have pretty oily skin. However, with winter and relatively new acne treatment, my skin is starting to get a bit drier and more sensitive. And because of this, more red! This toner has helped incredibly with redness and overall calming my sensitive skin-to the point where people have noticed.This is the one thing I've changed in my routine, so I know it has to be this product! It's incredibly light, great for when I'm both oily and dry. Just overall AMAZING! A new staple in my skin care!!!!
This is gentle and great on my skin. I am 30 years old with dry and sensative skin. Give it a try!!!
I use this product every day when I get out of the shower. It helps balance my skin tone and smooth my pores. I always follow with one of the facial sprays from the same brand.

I have combo skin with dry patches. Usually, after washing my face, exfoliating, and moisturizing my face looks like a whole strawberry. This is the first toner I have ever incorporated into my skincare routine. I applied it before my moisturizer and afterwards I couldn't believe that my redness was completely gone. incredible.

Bought this in hoping it was going to be a good product to replace my Mary Kay products . But it sadly felt like it was just water ... literally . But I didn't want to loose hope after first try, a week later . My face is breaking out even more, doesn't feel like I've been using a toner at all for awhile, so I feel disgusted at the same time. Will be returning this product highly disappointed.
I love the way it cleans my skin, I have been using this product for 2 months and I notice the difference it make to my skin. It helps to keep my skin hydrate and radiant.

I have been using this product in conjunction with the Enzyme cleansing jel and the pink face spritz. This combination has been a slam dunk for me. I have had terrible, embarrassing acne since I can honestly remember.. nothing has ever clear my skin, and it really has been very hard for me to deal with emotionally. Since I started using these products, I HAVE NOT GOTTEN ONE BREAKOUT. I am completely amazed. I am never felt better in my own skin. I can't wait to try more from this line. If you have sensitive, acne prone skin- TRY THIS!!!

So I have suffered from really bad acne and so has my daughter who's in her pre teen years. This toner helps calm down the acne, makes our face super skin while also moisturizing it. I'm on my 2nd bottle and will continue to use this one as my number #1 toner. I have more expensive toners but none of them come close to this one

This stuff is amazing and cleans makeup and debris off my face even after using 5 makeup wipes! It's so amazing that my boyfriend--a long-haired, tatted metalhead who never used anything expect the occasional scrub--demanded I buy him his own bottle. Gentle, powerful, and scent-free. Use one of their face sprays after!
I use it twice a day, after washing my face and before moisturizer. It's the only toner that actually get rid of my redness!

This is the best toner I have ever used! I have very sensitive skin that breaks out to a lot of products. I had no reaction to this. My skin has never been so clear and even toned! I swear by this toner!
I use this product twice a week. It peels off easy and leaves your face feeling tight and bright. I love it.

Are use this on my face every morning and night and my skin feels very soft and clean. I was using witch hazel before I bought this product I was already getting results with the witch hazel but I feel like this product was enhancing healthier skin faster than the witch hazel. The only thing I don't like is that the product will finish quickly if used daily.

avis.titre: Does not break my super sensitive dry skin out
avis.texte: Love this product I've been using it for about a month and it has not broke me out. I do not wear a lot of makeup though (only on my eyes and I use makeup remover wipes for that) so I can't say that it removes makeup (since I haven't tested it) but that aside I feel like this toner really balances the dryness and oils in my skin. I definitely would recommend people with acne proee skin to try this out!

avis.titre: Best toner I've had so far!
avis.texte: By far the best toner I've used so far. It feels so refreshing.
This is such a wonderful toner. It isn't harsh but does the job it's meant to do. I have severely sensitive and dry skin and this doesn't break me out or create dry patches.
This toner feels great on my skin! Very simple, clean and leaves me feeling refreshed. Great way to make sure you start your makeup/skincare routine with a clean base.

I'm new to learning about Mario Badescu as a brand but I love toners. This toner is absolutely fabulous!! If I'm not using my usual toner in my usual skin care routine, I'm always reaching for this Mario toner! Wow! I've never had a skin care product become my #2 most used product in that short of time! Amazing results - that's why.

got this in a sample size & it smelled like aloe! such a clean smell & it felt good going on. I decided to splurge on the big one & when I tried it....there was no smell & no great feeling. It was like water with green dye....I am wondering is this a fluke? did I somehow get a recall bottle or is it a completely different formula in the sample sizes??
I use this toner after every shower. My face has never been clearer. Correct my skin perfectly and prevents acne
I use this every morning before applying moisturizer and it works wonders for my skin! My skin is super soft.
I use this morning and night after cleansing. It's gentle and soothing.
This is the first toner that didn't break me out and gets the job done. It's a little expensive for a little bottle that lasts me about a month but it's well worth it.

This is a very clean product- its basically aloe, water, and some preservatives. I'm digging it for summer when my skin is just a bit irritated from being in the sun. I put some in an old Mac fix plus bottle for an all over refresh too. The one thing this won't do is address any skin issues like acne since there's no acids, etc.
Leaves my skin feeling fresh without any harsh chemicals or strong smells!

This toner is at a higher price point then I would normally buy but I was at a point where I was so disappointed with my sensitive rosecea skin. This was recommended on a YouTube video for my skin type. I just bought my second bottle. It's very light and really evens the skin tone. I look forward to using it every morning and night. I would highly recommend this for those with sensitive skin looking for a no nonsense toner with no chemicals.

avis.titre: I always have this product in stock! (plus an extra)
avis.texte: I use this product after I use a make up remover wipe to take off my make up. It removes all other impurities on my skin and leaves me feeling fresh and clean. It definitely takes off the dirt, oil, and makeup that the wipe does not get! Does not leave me dry or greasy. LOVE LOVE LOVE.
This is my second bottle. I love this product. I tell everyone about it.
I love the way this smells! It's super multi-functional, weather you tone after a shower or face wash, or use to set makeup!

Bought this by mistake, but totally ended up loving it!!!! It makes my skin feel SOOOO clean & so refreshed. & it takes off all the dirt that my makeup towels wont remove. I definitely recommend! It makes my skin a LITTLE dry, but i just put on some moisturizer afterwards & my skin feels GREAT.
Really pleased with this toner. Makeup even applies better since using!

I love this toner! I have a lot of allergies and sensitive skin. I tried so many toners that left my skin feeling wet, but not clean until I found Mario Badescu. I use this toner everyday and 1-2x/wk I alternate in the glycolic acid toner. My skin feels clean and looks brighter. In the warm weather I keep this in the fridge for a cool follow-up after washing my face.

This is a great toner because it doesn't have alcohol. Toners shouldn't have any alcohol, no matter your skin type. Great value and very natural and nonirritating. Hydrating and perfect for use morning and night after cleansing. Gets that last bit of makeup off and leave your skin feeling fresh.

avis.titre: Didn't do anything and it dried my skin
avis.texte: I didn't see any results with this toner. It soothed my skin a little bit but dried it as well. Not repurchasing.

avis.titre: I don't think it does anything
avis.texte: I don't see any difference beyond it removes leftover traces of makeup. Not sure if it really does anything. Will not buy again.
I love the Mario Badescu line! Everything I have bought has worked great and helped my dry, red, irritated skin. I will definitely keep using them.
